checks.text: The page displays the heading "Home Inventory" and, when no items exist, shows the text "No items yet".

Typing "Laptop" in the field labelled "Name", "Office" in the field labelled "Location", and "1200" in the field labelled "Value", then clicking the button "Add item", adds a row to the table containing "Laptop", "Office", and "$1,200.00"; the text "No items yet" is no longer visible.

After adding "Laptop" (Office, 1200), clicking the button "Sort by Value" changes the table header to show a descending sort indicator on the Value column, and the first data row in the table is "Laptop".
Typing "Lap" in the input field labelled "Search items" filters the table to show only the row containing "Laptop"; typing "Table" in the same field shows the text "No items match".

Clicking the button "Edit Laptop" opens a form pre-filled with "Laptop" in the Name field, "Office" in the Location field, and "1200" in the Value field; changing the Value field to "1500" and clicking "Save" updates the table row to show "$1,500.00".
With "Laptop" in the table, clicking the button "Delete Laptop" removes the row from the table and the text "No items yet" reappears.
Clicking the button "Export CSV" downloads a file containing the header row "Name,Location,Value" and a data row "Laptop,Office,1200" for the single existing item.
After adding "Laptop" (Office, 1200) and "Chair" (Living Room, 300), the table displays two rows, and the summary line at the bottom shows "Total value: $1,500.00".
Reload keeps the item "Laptop" with location "Office" and value "$1,200.00" visible in the table.
